name: smwsprites-pogo-toad
title: Pogo Toad
description:
Yay, my first fully functional sprite(s)! Inspired by a...rather unusual source, these little guys are 16x32 sprites that bounce around. One of them bounces up and down; the other bounces forward. LunarDrake drew the graphics, so if you use them, be sure to credit him as well.

Update 23/09/2020: SA-1 compatibility and .json conversions.
